instruction: A candid family photograph in an eye-level full shot captures a playful morning scene. In a cozy bedroom with patterned wallpaper and a white bed, the bearded man in a white t-shirt and striped pajama pants (R1) planks on a woven rug, laughing heartily. The woman in a white button-up shirt and matching pants (R3) sits on his lower back, laughing as she lifts the toddler in striped pajamas (R2) up in the air. Soft, natural indoor light fills the room, creating a warm and cheerful atmosphere.
